title: Microsoft 365 Apps admin center: Update Repair in Inventory
summary: The briefing passes: its controls, command, licensing requirement and rollout dates are supported. One descriptive overstatement should be narrowed: Microsoft documents downloading the latest build during Repair, but does not specify that every device downloads the full build.

claims.claim: Inventory setup is at Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Inventory > Get started, also printed in the table.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Apps Admin Center at config.office.com. Navigate to Inventory and choose Get started to enable the feature.

claims.claim: No automation for enabling Inventory is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps admin center Inventory enable setup Microsoft Graph API PowerShell; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/inventory and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/best-practices/roadmap-to-modern-management. No setup call found.

claims.claim: Remote repair is at Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Inventory > Review devices > Update Repair table > select one or more devices > Repair, also printed in the table.
claims.quote:
a notification banner appears on the Home and Inventory pages. Select Review devices in the banner to open Update Repair
In the Update Repair table, select one or more devices.
Select Repair and confirm the action.

claims.claim: No API or automation for the admin-centre Repair action is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Update Repair" "API" "Inventory"; "Update Repair" Microsoft Graph beta PowerShell repair action API. Opened https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/update-repair. Only the UI action and a local manual command were documented.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and .api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate tenant-wide switch to disable Update Repair or feature-specific restriction on who can start Repair is documented.

Opened https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/update-repair and the Inventory requirements. No separate setting found.

claims.claim: Manual Online Repair is at Windows > Installed apps (or Add or remove programs) > Microsoft 365 Apps > Modify or Change > Online Repair > Repair, also printed in the table.
claims.quote:
Open Installed apps (or Add or remove programs) in Windows.
Locate Microsoft 365 Apps and select Modify or Change.
Select Online Repair, then Repair, and follow the prompts.

claims.claim: The printed OfficeClickToRun.exe command performs manual Online Repair on a device.
claims.quote: "C:\Program Files\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\ClickToRun\OfficeClickToRun.exe" scenario=Repair platform=x64 RepairType=FullRepair forceappshutdown=True DisplayLevel=True
